remarks: This bright and airy 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo is a rare find in one of Norwalk's most desirable locations. Featuring an open concept living and dining area, this home has a seamless flow, perfect for both entertaining and daily living. The kitchen is well-appointed with plenty of counter space and cabinetry, ideal for home cooking enthusiasts. Upstairs, the generously sized bedrooms boast large closets and plenty of natural light. Step outside and enjoy peaceful walks to nearby Veterans Park or spend an afternoon in the heart of downtown Norwalk, filled with shops, restaurants, and cafes. Commuters will love the proximity to the train station, making travel to New York City or other neighboring towns a breeze. This condo is low maintenance living without sacrificing the conveniences of an active lifestyle. With ample parking, in-unit laundry, and a well-maintained building, this home is move-in ready and waiting for its next owner. Perfect for first-time homebuyers, downsizers, or anyone looking for a relaxed, convenient lifestyle in a thriving community. This opportunity won't last long!
